title: diabetes-xai-dependencygraph: guideline knowledge-graph audit of counterfactual recourse (diabetes, chronic kidney disease, hypertension)
description: Code, guideline dependency graphs in RDF Turtle with route provenance, SPARQL audit queries, internally time-stamped protocol and post-hoc plans with their SHA-256 hashes, deviation log and derived summary results for a guideline knowledge-graph audit of counterfactual recourse across three surveys (BRFSS, NHIS, NHANES), three diseases (diabetes, chronic kidney disease, hypertension) and six generators. Version 2.1.0 adds the rerun on a shared harmonised dataset (deviation D-P5): code in q1_v10/, results in eswa2026/results_v10/. Survey data, fitted models and guideline documents are not included. See eswa2026/README.md.
